description: Structured eval definitions for the CloudTrail Lake Query Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across CloudTrail Lake topologies (management EDS with data protection, data events EDS with selectors, multi-account Organization EDS, forensic query patterns, missing event type prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Management events EDS with PII data protection and CloudWatch alerting
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — management EDS, 90-day retention, EmailAddress + PhoneNumber masking, CloudWatch query failure alarm
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudTrail Lake event data store for management events. EDS name: mgmt-events-eds. Retention: 90 days. I need data protection to mask EmailAddress and PhoneNumber. CloudWatch alarm for query failures to SNS arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:ct-lake-alerts.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDTRAIL_LAKE: mgmt-events-eds
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Event type: Management events
  [✓] Retention: 90 days
  [✓] Data protection: EmailAddress, PhoneNumber masked
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudtrail list-event-data-stores

eval_cases.name: Data events EDS with advanced selectors for S3 write events
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — data events EDS, selectors for PutObject/DeleteObject on specific bucket, 365-day retention
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudTrail Lake event data store for data events. EDS name: s3-audit-eds. I only need S3 PutObject and DeleteObject events on bucket arn:aws:s3:::audit-bucket/. Retention: 365 days. No management events.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDTRAIL_LAKE: s3-audit-eds
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Event type: Data events
  [✓] Advanced selectors: S3 PutObject, DeleteObject on audit-bucket
  [✓] Retention: 365 days
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudtrail list-event-data-stores

eval_cases.name: Multi-account Organization EDS with 7-year retention and data protection
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Organization EDS, all member accounts, management events, 2555-day retention
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudTrail Lake event data store for my Organization. I need management events from ALL member accounts (5 accounts). EDS name: org-mgmt-eds. Retention: 2555 days (7 years). Data protection to mask EmailAddress. Management account: 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDTRAIL_LAKE: org-mgmt-eds
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Multi-account: Organization EDS (5 member accounts)
  [✓] Retention: 2555 days
  [✓] Data protection: EmailAddress masked
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudtrail list-event-data-stores

eval_cases.name: Forensic EDS with query patterns for security investigation
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — management EDS for forensic querying, query patterns for who-deleted-X and what-did-user-Y-do
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudTrail Lake EDS for forensic investigation. EDS name: forensic-eds. Management events. Retention 365 days. I need to be able to query who deleted resources and what specific users did. Show me the forensic query patterns.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDTRAIL_LAKE: forensic-eds
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Event type: Management events
  [✓] Forensic queries: who-deleted, what-user-did, unusual-login, root-activity
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws cloudtrail-data start-query --query-statement ...

eval_cases.name: EDS without event type decision (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — event type not decided; EDS type is immutable after creation
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudTrail Lake event data store. EDS name: undecided-eds. I am not sure which event types I need. Just create it for now and I will figure out the event types later.
eval_cases.expected_output:
CLOUDTRAIL_LAKE: undecided-eds
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Event type: MISSING — event type (management, data, Insights) must be decided at creation; EDS type is immutable and cannot be changed later
